adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Homozygous CYP7A1 loss with reduced bile-acid synthesis, hypercholesterolemia and early gallstones identifies impaired cholesterol 7alpha-hydroxylation in the classic bile-acid pathway.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: UGT1A1 and MRP2 are bilirubin pathways, MTTP packages ApoB lipoproteins, and HMG-CoA reductase synthesizes cholesterol rather than initiating its conversion to bile acids.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: The answer relies on the initial CYP7A1 reaction; no numerical threshold is required.
